summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO prototype with a brass-framed menu, realm roster and character-creation flow leading to the Lantern March continent. MMORPG Tools owns front-door and character lifecycle/UI; ordered player behaviors compose movement, class combat, quests and trade, while scene builders provide the world and its landmarks.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - title/front door with the monumental Realm Gate, lanterns and realm-list/character UI backdrop.
places/character-creation-land/ - character preview and creation at the Wayshrine; its look and scene are separate from gameplay lighting.
places/main/ - streamed Lantern March continent; config owns its terrain, coast, roads, scatter and atmosphere.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub and many town buildings, NPCs, services and interactions.
places/main/cells/x-6z1.scene, x7z-1.scene and x2z11.scene - Thornhollow, Cinderhold and Gullrest starting settlements; region names are also classified in scripts/lib/regions.js and the HUD.
places/main/cells/ - Briarwild, Emberstone Quarry, farms, distant landmarks and race-start regions distributed across streamed continent cells.
roots: world.config.yaml - main-menu-land default entry; binds player/camera, MMORPG UI, nametag, arrival behavior, realm routing and once-a-minute realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod.json - registers MMORPG player/menu, character creation, camera and interaction behaviors.
templates/player.js#player - ordered behavior chain: humanoid locomotion, core movement, Vanguard, Arcanist, Pathfinder, quest-player and vendor.
templates/camera.js#camera - core camera template using scripts/camera.js; MMORPG orbit and creation preview cameras are distinct.
places/main/config.yaml - continent spawn, gravity, terrain/coast, material, road/flattening marks and scatter configuration.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, save helpers, UI panels and front-door modules consumed by mod behaviors and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - per-realm character SQL load/upsert/delete and realm-roster population helper; used by menu and player lifecycle.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - room roster consumed by scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js; realm-save.js separately defines its roster in code.
scripts/lib/economy.js and MMORPG lib/currency.js - copper transaction/ledger and currency formatting shared by gameplay, vendor and UI.
scripts/lib/data/quests.yml, townsfolk.yml and wolves.yml - quest, dialogue and pack definitions read by their gameplay behaviors.
scripts/lib/regions.js and scripts/terrain-reach.js - continent regions and height/coast functions used by terrain and region display.

scripts/gen/shape.js plus gen/house.js, hamlet.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, farm.js, windmill*, frontier.js, briar.js, quarry.js and reach-* - procedural scene geometry reused by placed instances.
scripts/lib/kit.js, scripts/lib/missiles.js and scripts/gen/arrow.js - shared asset-kit and projectile/arrow infrastructure for builders and class abilities.
notableExports: scripts/routing.js - pickRoom; crons/realm-pulse.js - cron; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/main-menu-mgr.js - roster selection/hydration, update, onSpawn and onInput; lib/ui-character-roster.js - renderCharacterRoster.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/character-select.js - preview lifecycle, onSpawn, update and onInput; lib/version.js - GAME_VERSION, GAME_TITLE, versionTag.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js - character build/save/load, lifecycle, movement helpers, logout and onLeave.
scripts/player.js - onInput/update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - sit/onInput/update; class scripts expose their combat handlers.
scripts/quest-player.js - onInput/update; scripts/vendor.js - coin-event/vendor interaction; scripts/townsfolk.js - resident behavior.
scripts/lib/economy.js - move and formatting; MMORPG lib/realm-save.js - realm persistence and roster helpers.
scripts/gen/hamlet.js, realm-gate.js and wayshrine.js - geometry/collider; scripts/material-realm-veil.js - material; scripts/look-wayshrine.js - look.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw and animation channels; behavior ordering lets gait sample movement velocity.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots, persisted character records; character-select and main-menu-mgr own front-door transitions.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; scripts/wolves.js owns pack AI and den/death timers.
scripts/quest-player.js - per-player quest, tally, inventory/xp/dialog/cache state and timber interaction; woodcutting.js owns tree fall/regrowth presentation.
scripts/vendor.js and scripts/lib/economy.js - purse transactions and coin ledger movement; vendor also handles incoming coin events.
scripts/townsfolk.js - resident idle/facing state; quest-player owns per-player dialogue sequence and quest progress.
MMORPG ui.js and lib/ui-*.js - render from player/mod state; panels do not own persistent character data.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → main gameplay lifecycle.
Fresh MMORPG player load resets to title; main-menu-mgr loads the current room's SQL roster, opens the realm list on first realm visit and refreshes population/character counts.
Realm menu pick/join → main-menu-mgr api.cross to the selected room's main-menu-land; world routing validates requested room, then last room, then main using realms.yml.
scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js read realms.yml; each room cron writes player count to realm_pulse, which realm-save reads for the roster UI.
Character creation race/class → mod lib/races.js race start and character state → player.js/realm-save upsert to realm characters table; saves retain the realm/slot identity.
templates/player.js → humanoid-locomotion → player → Vanguard → Arcanist → Pathfinder → quest-player → vendor; preserve this order and shared inputs.
moveX/moveZ/jump and orbit/steer/autorun → player.js and wow-move.js room-local intent → body motion under place gravity.
attack/cast inputs → class abilities and scripts/lib/missiles.js → targets/wolves; wolf slow/hit state is consumed by wolves.js.
wolves.js reads wolves.yml and spawns gen/wolf entities → AI/combat/death/respawn; kills award XP and emit coins events to player vendor behavior.
interact/quest inputs → quest-player resolves quest NPC, talker, readable, cache or timber; quest-data/quests.yml drives accept/complete and UI actions.
Quest reward/vendor/loot → economy copper move and ledger/purse updates → vendor/UI; character changes are snapshotted and saved through MMORPG player.js/realm-save.js.
main-menu-land scene uses gen/realm-gate.js plus material-realm-veil; character-creation-land uses gen/wayshrine.js and look-wayshrine.js for its distinct backdrop.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, hamlet.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, farm.js, windmill*, frontier.js, briar.js, quarry.js and reach-* - builders recur across scene instances, varied by kind, seed and dimensions.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter reused by place bindings, varied by density/scale/seed; grass-look supplies its material separately.
MMORPG player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle registered by mod.json.
MMORPG camera.js/camera-creation.js and menu-camera.js - gameplay, creation-preview and menu framing camera paths with phase/place guards.
MMORPG lib/ui-*.js - modular renderers composed by ui.js for HUD, menu/roster, quests, vendor, inventory, map, character and settings.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js with class data - class-selected combat actions share targets and projectile infrastructure.
scripts/wolves.js with wolves.yml and gen/wolf.js - configured pack manager reuses AI/combat behavior, varied by spawn row and hit/slow state.
scripts/quest-player.js, elric.js, townsfolk.js, vendor.js and woodcutting.js - interaction behaviors vary by target tags and per-player/NPC state.
probableOrphans: scripts/db.js - schema migration helper; realm-save refers to its schema, but current callers of migrate are not identified.
scripts/lib/data/races.yml - race/start data is mirrored in MMORPG lib/races.js and appears to have no runtime reader.
scripts/gen/zz-cardtest.js - temporary-looking card-test geometry with no reference found in the current package.
migrationNotes: Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route transactions through economy/coin handling to keep purse, ledger and UI aligned.
templates/player.js behavior order is significant: locomotion before movement, then classes, quests and vendor; gait samples prior-tick velocity.
Movement intent/locomotion scratch is room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity.

Realm sources differ: routing and pulse read scripts/lib/data/realms.yml, while realm-save.js hardcodes room IDs (including realm-prefixed non-main IDs); keep roster, route and save room identifiers aligned.
Persisted character fields must travel through player.js build/load data and realm-save signatures while preserving the (user, realm, slot) key; legacy storage import is main-realm-only.
lib/version.js owns the displayed game version; the menu, settings and pause version tag consume it, not gameplay HUD.
